newsitem.title: THAILAND: Somprasong president wanted for fraud.
newsitem.headline: Somprasong president wanted for fraud.

text.p: Thai police said on Tuesday they have issued a warrant for the arrest of the president of property firm Somprasong Land Plc on charges of falsifying the company's financial statements.
Police from the Economic Crime Investigation Division told reporters they will charge Prasong Panichpakdi when he surrenders to police.
"The warrant was approved by the Interior Ministry on October 24," Police Major General Vinai Pao-in told reporters.
Police said Prasong has contacted police and is expected to surrender in one or two days.
If found guilty, Prasong faces up to 10 years in jail and up to one million baht ($40,000) in fines.
Somprasong officials said they would not comment on the charges against the company president. An official told Reuters Prasong had not gone to the company's office on Tuesday.
The Stock Exchange of Thailand earlier halted trading in shares of Somprasong pending a disclosure from the company.
Somprasong's share price has been hit in recent months by concerns over the company's liquidity position, brokers said.
Somprasong was down 0.80 baht, or 9.52 percent, at a year low of 7.60 baht when it was halted. -- Bangkok newsroom
